subject: IFEval kickoff — instruction-following as a release gate
body: Team — kicking off IFEval productization for the language portfolio. Base: our open-source instruction-following eval, which scores models on verifiable instructions ('write a 300+ word summary', 'answer in exactly three bullet points') from jsonl prompt/response pairs, reporting strict and loose accuracy at both prompt and instruction level. Goal: make IFEval a first-class gate in Evalline so every language-model release gets an instruction-following regression check — Tomas's team is expecting our integration spec. Milestones: harness integrated behind Evalline's runner API by June 5; baseline sweep across our current model fleet by June 19; Launch Review sign-off for gating by mid-July. Stretch goal we'll discuss at resourcing: using the eval as a training signal for improving small models, not just measuring them. Alina will send the staffing plan. — Priya
